title: Quote the Raven
narrativeText: The lights drop. When they return, Raven is crouched in the corner of the ring, staring at nothing. He raises the microphone. 'This is not a wrestling match. This is a reckoning. And quoth the Raven — nevermore.' The crowd is silent. Then he rises.

choices.label: Step Into the Darkness
choices.text: Words are done. Only violence remains.

title: Concrete Revelation
narrativeText: Raven doesn't wait for the ring. He takes the fight to the concrete floor outside, where there are no ropes and no rules even attempted. He whips the opponent into the guardrail, then drops — DDT on the bare floor. The crowd goes absolutely silent, then erupts.

choices.label: Take It to the Floor
choices.text: The ring is a suggestion. The concrete is where the truth lives.
